label: MOGAD optic neuritis post enterovirus meningitis: a new association.
summary: Myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD) is a rare autoimmune demyelinating disorder of the central nervous system, typically presenting with optic neuritis, transverse myelitis or acute disseminated encephalomyelitis. While viral triggers such as Epstein-Barr virus and adenovirus have been reported, an association with enterovirus meningitis is not well documented.
